messages:
mike: kicking off changewindow for service-inference v3.2.1 — rolling canary to 10% in eu-west now. change window ends 2024-08-12T22:00Z
.deploy-bot: [deploy] started rollout v3.2.1 -> canary targets: inference-eu-west-1, traffic=10%
.sana: heads up — will watch SLO panels (p95/p99 latency, 5xx rate, kvcache miss). Link: https://grafana.redwood/s/dash/serving-canary
.eva: saw a small spike preflight in tail latency earlier, but cleared. watching.
.deploy-bot: canary healthcheck: all checks passed for initial smoke (startup, healthz)
.mike: ok we shifted to 25% now; notify if any error budgets nudge
.sana: alert: embeds-route eu-west 504s increased to 0.6% over baseline — attaching log snippet :eyes: 
.sana: snippet from logs:
```
2024-08-12T21:12:03Z inference-eu-west embed-handler ERROR upstream timeout (client=svc-frontend)
req_id=abc123 route=embed_v1 seq_len=64 model=embed-l2
```
.nora: is this new model variant pinned with runtime v3.2.1 quantize? could be kernel mismatch
.eva: checking metrics — tail-99p for short sequences jumped from 220ms -> 1.4s; p95 ok. that's a sign of occasional long tail
.mike: can we confirm if this correlates with kvcache GC on nodes? sana?
.sana: correlates with GC spikes on node-7 at 21:11:58 — GC pause ~900ms, yes. also deploy-bot shows new sidecar tracer /agent v4 loaded on these nodes
.deploy-bot: canary traffic rebalanced: routing 50% of embed traffic to fallback model embed-v1-fallback for safety
.eva: great — embeddings 504s dropping back to 0.08% after fallback routing :thumbsup:
.mike: decision time — keep rolling to 50% and monitor 15m, or pause and pin to previous model? thoughts?
.sana: pause ramp. pin embed-route on eu-west to embed-v1-fallback and continue rest of v3.2.1 for gen routes. we'll avoid full rollback
.nora: docs/release notes: add note about embed model incompatibility with sidecar tracer; file a follow-up postmortem
.deploy-bot: action: traffic pinned for route=embed_v1 -> version=embed-v1-fallback (pin id=pin-2384)
.mike: thanks — updating release notes and notifying customer-success. I'll mark change-window as "partial pause — embed route pinned"
.eva: monitoring alert: SLO drift returning to baseline. keeping watch for 30m.
.sana: follow-up item: ops/infra will schedule a kernel compatibility patch for sidecar v4 in next sprint. @mike @nora
.mike: noted. good call everyone. :eyes:
